title: One Prime Studio, launch film v2 (problem to solution)

direction.logline: Every business is losing customers it never sees. One Prime Studio turns that around: a brand people remember, a website that brings leads, systems that run the business. Built as one, from Hyderabad, for everywhere.
story: ACT 1, THE PROBLEM (dark, reverb, glitch): a website nobody finds, a brand that blends in, tools that never talk, customers walking past. It all collapses into one dot.
ACT 2, THE TURN (flash, shockwave, drop): 'Not anymore.' The dot explodes into white. The switch flips on: One Prime Studio.
ACT 3, THE SOLUTION (white, cash hits): each fix lands with a cash sound and a swinging card; enquiries, bookings and orders pour in.
ACT 4, AS ONE (absorb): design, development and software are pulled into one point, which opens into the dithered globe; arcs fire from Hyderabad to the world.
SIGN-OFF: the lockup, 'Average is not an option.', Start a project.
direction.type: PP Neue Montreal only. Every heading uses the site's goo blur, run fast (0.5 s). No mono, no navbar, no cursor, no em dashes anywhere, on screen or in the voice.

easing.prime: cubic-bezier(0.87, 0, 0.13, 1): reveals, wipes, card lifts, the absorb

effects: Shake: every hit kicks the camera (decaying, about 18 px), plus a slow handheld drift in Act 1.
Flash: white frames on the drops, ink frames on the hits in white scenes.
Chromatic split: red/blue offsets on glitches and hits.
Swing: cards and chips hang from a pivot and swing in on a damped pendulum.
Absorb: elements spiral into a single point with a suck, then the point blooms.
Shockwave: a ring of Bayer dither expands from the explosion.
Vignette and grain in Act 1; clean white in Act 3.

sound.music: Original funk / phonk at 130 BPM, written for the film (the licensed songs named in the brief can't be bundled; see deliverables). Act 1: a slowed, filtered cowbell and a sub drone with a heartbeat. 'Not anymore': the full drop, distorted 808 slides, tamborzao-style kick pattern, claps, rolling hats, phonk cowbell melody, a formant 'hey' chop. A breakdown under 'Built as one', a second drop on 'everywhere', a final hit on the sign-off.
sound.ducking: Music dips under every word: mids -9 dB, lows -5 dB, 30 ms look-ahead, 280 ms release.
sound.voice: Problem lines go dark: pitched down, long hall reverb and a dotted-eighth echo. Everything else is close and dry.
sound.sfx: Flash hits with reverb tails, risers, sub drops, shockwave, glitch stutters, error buzz, heartbeat and flatline, cash register and coins on every solution, notification pings, absorb suck, swooshes, the switch.

treatment.problem: hall 2.6 s at 34% wet, dotted-eighth echo 26% with feedback, low-pass 6 kHz
treatment.default: HPF 90 Hz, presence, 3:1 compression, faint doubler

scenes.title: A website nobody finds
picture: Night. A clean white browser card swings down from a pivot, a nice site inside it (hero block, nav pills, image).
'Your website looks fine.' goos in above.
p2: a search bar types, a results list scrolls fast past the camera, the site is not in it; the card flickers, glitches and greys out.

scenes.title: A brand that blends in
picture: A wall of 30 identical grey marks; one of them is yours, outlined in blue.
On 'blends' the wall shuffles fast (every mark swaps places twice), the blue outline fades, and yours is lost.

scenes.title: Tools that never talk

vo.text: Your tools don't talk to each other.

picture: Five app tiles (Sheets, Mail, Billing, Calendar, CRM) drop in and swing.
Dashed lines reach between them and snap, one by one, with a red flicker and a buzz; the tiles drift apart.

scenes.title: Customers walk past

vo.text: And every day, customers walk past.

picture: A doorway of light in the dark. A stream of dots (people) flows left to right past it; none turns in.
A heartbeat line runs under it and flattens. Everything darkens and collapses to one dot in the centre.

scenes.title: Not anymore
picture: 'Not': the dot explodes, a white flash, a dither shockwave rings out, heavy shake; the world turns white.
'Not anymore.' huge, gooing in, swinging on its baseline.
'One': the switch flips on with a blue bloom; 'Prime Studio' forms; the lockup swings to rest.

scenes.title: The solution

vo.text: A website that brings in leads.
Systems that run your business for you.

picture: s1: the wall of grey marks returns, and yours lifts out of it in ink and blue, swings forward and grows; the rest fall away. Cash hit.
s2: the browser card from Act 1 swings back in, alive; notifications stack onto it on the beat: New enquiry, New booking, New order. Cash hit and a coin on each.
s3: the five tools return and lock into one hub (the switch) with solid lines; pulses flow along them; checks cascade. Cash hit.

scenes.title: Built as one
picture: Three ink 4:5 cards swing in on their words: Design, Development, Software.
'Built as': they start to orbit a centre point, faster and smaller (absorb).
'one': they vanish into the point with a flash; the point blooms into the dithered globe.

scenes.title: Hyderabad to everywhere
picture: The globe (2 px Bayer land grain) spins and swings to India; the Hyderabad node lands with rings.
'everywhere': zoom punch, the globe spins west, arcs fire to seven cities on 16ths with flashes on each landing.

scenes.title: Sign-off

vo.text: One Prime Studio. Average is not an option.

picture: Seam train to white. The lockup swings in and the switch flips on with 'One'.
'Average is not an option.' word by word.
'Start a project' fills with ink on PRIME, a final cash hit, hello@oneprimestudio.com gooing in under it.

deliverables: out/oneprime-about-v2.mp4: full mix with the original funk score
out/oneprime-about-v2-nomusic.mp4: voice + effects only, so a licensed track (Timeless, an automotivo or aura-farming sound) can be added inside Instagram, where those songs are licensed
Drop a licensed WAV at public/about2/music.wav and run npm run about2:mix to have it ducked under the voice automatically
